transcript: This time tomorrow I will be sitting in a meeting room At ten I will be attending a lecture And in the afternoon I will be finishing the new project file I have waited a long time for this appointment For more than a month I have been making steady progress On the same day my colleague will also be engaged in another task After lunch, I would probably move on to the afternoon meeting By evening, I will nearly complete the report Sometimes I wonder where I will be a year from now Three years, life will continue And I too will be living through many more days Placing myself within a schedule gives the day A gentle momentum This time, tomorrow I will most likely be sitting at my desk But beyond that single moment Another tomorrow Is already waiting quietly

segments.text: This time tomorrow I will be sitting in a meeting room
At ten I will be attending a lecture
And in the afternoon I will be finishing the new project file
I have waited a long time for this appointment
For more than a month I have been making steady progress
On the same day my colleague will also be engaged in another task
After lunch, I would probably move on to the afternoon meeting
By evening, I will nearly complete the report
Sometimes I wonder where I will be a year from now
And I too will be living through many more days
Placing myself within a schedule gives the day
I will most likely be sitting at my desk
